A companion to [Nonprofit award disruption, 2025–26](disruption-2025.html),
built from the same cohorts, categories and flags. The ledger signals are
the ones `us_disruption_flags()` defines (see `vignette("disruption")`),
computed here on all 1.47 million actions of both cohorts; the tables are
pre-computed from the nonprofit database, which is not shipped with the
package.

## Ten awards, start to finish

Each row is one award picked by rule from the 2025 cohort: an award with
File C outlays in at least three quarters before January 2025, closest to
$1.5 million obligated, matching the pattern named on the left. Hover a mark
for the action and its description text.

```{=html}
<div class="usr"><div class="fig">
  <p class="ft">Ledger actions, schedule and cash, October 2023 – December 2027</p>
  <p class="fs">Grey bar: the end date in force on 20 January 2025. Dark line: the end date now. Blue blocks underneath: cash paid out each quarter (File C), scaled within each award.</p>
  <div class="legend" id="l-lanes"></div>
  <div class="chart" id="c-lanes"></div>
</div></div>
```

Award identifiers and recipient names are in the hover cards.

## Sources

USAspending annual award archives FY2008–FY2026 (generated 2026-09-06)
filtered to the npmatch nonprofit crosswalk; File C account outlays via
`POST /awards/funding/`. Cohorts, categories and flags as in the main report
(flags v2); ledger signals from `us_disruption_flags()`. Tables built by
pipeline stage 29 (`29_disruption_visuals.R` → `visuals_tables.json`) on
<span id="m-built"></span>.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
report_script("visuals", c(V = "visuals_tables.json"))
```
